## Looking for the receipt

Called by the matching batch, only when the Monthly Update skill's
`Gmail (read-only)` credential happens to be connected. Everything works
without it; reviews just hand more transactions to a person.

It searches the user's own mailbox for a receipt matching one payment, and
copies out what the document says. It reads body text only: attachments are
not fetched.

A supplier bill cannot explain money arriving, and a total that does not
match to the cent is marked weak rather than treated as proof.
